_: An electrode material. NOTHING in data/materials.json exists yet, and this template is written from the schema rather than copied from a real record — because writing one from memory is exactly what the first rule forbids. Every number here must carry a citation.
name: Hard carbon
_mechanism: The id of the storage mechanism record. Cross-checked.
summary: One or two sentences. What it is and why anyone uses it.

properties._: EVERY numeric property is a value object. provenance must be `literature` or `datasheet` with a source, or `measured` with a date. A number with a unit and no provenance is an ERROR and renders as "Unverified".

theoreticalCapacity.note: State the stoichiometry it was derived from.

reportedCapacity._source: DOI or full citation. Required — an error without it.
reportedCapacity._note: A single literature number is rarely meaningful on its own. Prefer a RANGE with the conditions, and say which: rate, electrolyte, voltage window, mass loading.

specificSurfaceArea._note: Say which technique. BET area is not electrochemically accessible area — see technique.bet.

conditions._: The conditions any reported value was measured under. A capacity with no rate, electrolyte and window is not a comparable number.

preparation: Reference to the preparation route, or a short description.
_characterisedBy: Technique ids normally used on this material. Cross-checked.
limitations: What it does badly, and under what conditions.
